target_visibility.description: One large multirotor UAV is plainly visible throughout the selected window.

acceptance_rule: A target-level detection must localize the aircraft as one object, rather than a small component or unrelated background patch.

finding.reason: Review of the frozen boxes found small boxes on aircraft details and background vegetation, but no box localizing the complete UAV.

limits: No pixel-accurate ground-truth bounding boxes were created in this checkpoint.
This review supports a qualitative failure finding, not a dataset-level precision, recall, mAP, HOTA, or MOTA claim.
The clip is a close-range positive case and does not represent long-range or negative-scene performance.
